variants.notes: Autech brochure: 'このカタログのエンジン出力表示はすべて「ネット値」です' (all outputs are net). Tuning per GAZOO: dedicated high-compression pistons, dedicated ECU/ROM, lower exhaust back pressure, retuned valve timing and lift; the brochure lists an Autech exhaust manifold/front tube and a NISMO lightweight flywheel. Cam figures were not published and are left out.
